The narrative focuses on archaeological evidence, theories, and the haunting silence left behind. Follow niche topic strategy: Scour global news, academic journals, and Reddit communities for the most talked-about lost civilization. Identify if any new LiDAR scans, satellite imagery, or underwater excavations have been published recently. Generate a topic that combines mystery with scientific credibility — something that sparks debate and encourages comments and shares.

Forbidden: talking-head lip-sync avatar, burned-in captions, watermark, modern meme text, modern smartphones, cars, LED screens, sneakers.
